pages.en:
463
19/7/16
Shanghai Municipal Council.
July 20th 1916
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE (DETECTIVE BRANCH)）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)
Sir,
It is reported that the Chinese journalists Association
will entertain the M.P.s in the Y.M.C.A. or Cotton Yarn
Guild on 21st instant.
Sun Yat Sen and Huang Hsin intend to remain in
Shanghai for the present. The latter has told friends
that he does not wish to take up any government position.
Zoo Koh Liang 徐國樑 Chief of the Chinese Police
visited Dr. Sun Yat Sen yesterday afternoon.
Your Obedient Servant
Chief Detective Inspector.
Captain Superintendent of Police.
pages.zh:
463
19/7/16
上海工部局。
1916年7月20日
（印：上海工部局警务处（侦探股））
警务处，
（侦探股）
先生：
据报，中国记者协会将于本月21日在青年会或棉纱公会宴请国会议员。
孙中山与黄兴拟暂时留驻上海。后者曾向友人表示，其不愿担任任何政府职务。
华界巡警总监徐国梁于昨日下午拜访了孙逸仙博士。
您忠实的仆人
总探长。
警务处总监。
